Câu chuyện bắt đầu với Trương Tuyền, là một người có khả năng nhìn thấy ma. Thuở niên thiếu, Trương Tuyền mong muốn người xung quanh hiểu được yêu ma cũng có loài thiện lẫn ác. Nhưng kết quả lại không được như vậy, cậu đành trở lại nhịp sống vô vị của mình, mãi cho đến khi cậu gặp Thẩm Khánh – một người bình thường luôn bị ma quỷ quấy rối. Sau cuộc tiếp xúc, Trương Tuyền vô tình khiến Thẩm Khánh nhìn thấy được ma. Cũng từ đây mà nổ ra trận náo nhiệt truy đuổi yêu ma diễn ra như cơm bữa.

description.en: The sixth prince of Southern Chu was selected as his son-in-law, and died of a serious illness on his way to the Western Qin Kingdom. The hero’s soul passed through the prince and became a waste of Chai Lin Feng, and at the same time activated the super option system. With the prompt and help of the super option system, Lin Feng broke through the limitations of cultivation and started a life of counterattack. As Lin Feng’s strength became stronger and stronger, he also made a few friends and confidantes. With his extraordinary talents, he was admitted to Donglin Wonderland to cultivate immortals. He reached the pinnacle of life and triggered the main task of the system. “Choose to become a god.” But the stronger Lin Feng’s ability, he saw the dark competition and devouring side of various races and forces, when Lin Feng rescued these races, he also constantly activated more tasks and reward mechanisms in the super option system, and the system itself became smarter and smarter. Human nature helped Lin Feng finish the multiple roads to becoming gods.
description.id: Pangeran keenam Chu Selatan dipilih sebagai menantu, dan meninggal karena penyakit serius dalam perjalanan ke Kerajaan Qin Barat. Jiwa pahlawan Menyebrang masuk ke dalam tubuh pangeran dan bergabung menjadi Lin Feng, dan pada saat yang sama Sistem Pilihan Super Diaktifkan. Dengan cepat dari bantuan sistem pilihan super, Lin Feng menerobos batasan kultivasi dan memulai kehidupan Balas Dendamnya. Saat kekuatan Lin Feng menjadi lebih kuat dan lebih kuat, dia juga membuat beberapa teman dan orang kepercayaan. Dengan bakatnya yang luar biasa, dia diterima di Negeri Ajaib Donglin untuk menkultivasi keabadian dalam kasus khusus. Dia mencapai puncak kehidupan dan memicu tugas utama sistem "Pilih untuk menjadi dewa." Tetapi semakin kuat kemampuan Lin Feng, dia melihat persaingan gelap dan sisi pemakan berbagai kelompok etnis dan kekuatan. Ketika Lin Feng menyelamatkan kelompok etnis ini, dia juga terus-menerus mengaktifkan lebih banyak tugas dan mekanisme penghargaan dalam sistem pilihan super. menjadi lebih dan lebih cerdas, Sifat manusia membantu Lin Feng menyelesaikan banyak jalan untuk menjadi dewa.
description.zh: 南楚六皇子被选为赘婿，前往西秦国的路上重病而亡，男主的灵魂穿越到皇子体内，成为了废柴林枫，同时激活了超级选项系统。林枫在超级选项系统的提示和帮助下，突破了修炼的限制，开启了逆袭的人生。随着林枫实力的越来越强，也结交了几个好友和红颜知已，凭借过人的天赋异秉还被特例收纳到东临仙境修仙，一路走上人生巅峰，还触发了系统的主线任务“成神选择”。但林枫能力越强，看到的各族群与势力的黑暗竞争吞食的一面，林枫在解救这些族群的时候也不断激活着超级选项系统中更多的任务和奖励机制，系统本身也越来越智能人性起来，帮助林枫完在了多重成神之路。

description.en: After living through ten thousand lives, Chen Luo has mastered everything from ancient languages to the art of the master thief. Now, back in the classroom of his youth, he’s no longer a helpless student—he’s a man with the ultimate cheat code: absolute knowledge of the future and everyone’s darkest secrets.
description.pt-br: Depois de viver dez mil vidas, Chen Luo dominou tudo — desde línguas antigas até a arte de um mestre ladrão. Agora, de volta à sala de aula da sua juventude, ele não é mais um estudante indefeso — é um homem com o código de trapaça supremo: conhecimento absoluto do futuro e dos segredos mais obscuros de todos.

description.en: Eccentric girl Yin Ying finally got into the university of her dreams, but she unexpectedly discovers that Ji Yuchuan, the arrogant and gifted senior, is her first love whom she lost contact with for four years. After a huge misunderstanding, the two started a "game", pretending to be a couple. His life is now disturbed by her social butterfly behavior, yet his heart never seemed to stop beating - On the road of my chasing dreams, you were there. The curtains of this show of confusing love is about to be lifted~!
description.zh: 鬼马少女尹莺终于考上梦想的大学，意外发现那孤傲的天才学长纪雨川就是自己失联四年的初恋。一场乌龙，两人开始了假扮情侣的“游戏”。他的生活就此被她的社牛行为搅乱，心动却似乎从未止息——追梦路上与你同在，扑朔迷离的恋爱博弈拉开序幕～！
description.pt-br: A excêntrica garota Yin Ying finalmente entrou na universidade dos seus sonhos, mas inesperadamente descobre que Ji Yuchuan, o arrogante e talentoso Veterano, é seu primeiro amor com quem ela perdeu contato por quatro anos. Após um grande desentendimento, os dois iniciaram uma “brincadeira”, fazendo-se passar por um casal. A vida dele agora é perturbada pelo comportamento social dela, mas seu coração parecia nunca parar de bater - Na estrada dos meus sonhos perseguidos, você estava lá. As cortinas desta demonstração de amor confuso estão prestes a ser levantadas~

I was a surgeon from a modern era who transmigrated into an ancient world. Fate had it that I was to transmigrate into the body of a consort of the imperial family. Due to some previous actions by the original owner of the body, I was despised by the prince, and my sister hated me. Originally, I had no interest in matters of the heart, and I was perfectly happy to live a relaxed life in peace. However, things spiraled out of control when my sister began meddling in my affairs. 

Unbeknownst to everyone around me, I'm no longer the same person they knew. Not only am I skilled with a knife, but I'm used to seeing blood as well. You can't even begin to understand the things I've seen and been through.

Em seu desespero, ele descobre que no outro mundo pode criar jogos e convocar jogadores.  Luwu conseguirá começar do zero e alcançar seu objetivo de vingança como um mentor nos bastidores, tornando-se o novo governante do submundo?

description.en:
While binge-watching a popular drama, Ningxuan unexpectedly transmigrated into the drama's universe. She was the evil, arrogant fake daughter now, who relentlessly bullied the real daughter and kept causing trouble for herself. Whenever she thought of the terrible fate in store for her... To avoid this fate, Ningxuan returned everything to the true daughter and even avoided conflict with the main cast at all costs to live her life in peace. And yet—

"I was wrong about you. If it's possible, can we start over?" The male lead said.
Ningxuan responded, "What the heck? Bro, your true love is over there!"

"Since the day you rescued me, my life has belonged to you..." The male supporting character answered.
"Wake up! She's your savior, not me!" Ningxuan retorted. 

The female lead exclaimed, "I know you're the only person who treats me well in this world, so... once I get rid of all these men bothering you, you'll be mine!"

description.en: The arrogant and cold Yu Xingji, the leader of the Twelve constellation deities, traded his memories in exchange for reincarnating a thousand times in order to find his true love. During his 1001st reincarnation, he's reborn into the life of a college professor, where he meets Qin Ling, an aloof young man in possession of strange spiritual powers. When a strange event suddenly happens on the school campus, Yu Xingji couldn’t help but find himself standing in front of Qin Ling to protect him during the most critical moment!While the relentless reincarnation cycles may have erased the memories and appearance of his lover, only the emotions carved in his bones and engraved in the heart will guide them to reunite once again.

description.en: Tang, a charming noble, almost met his end at the hands of a sleazy prince. Luckily, he awakens to find himself in the home of Cheng, the stunning stranger-turned-bandit who saved him! While recovering in the mountains, the unlikely pair form a bond, but they eventually go their separate ways. Even so, they can’t stop thinking about each other... is there a happily ever after for them, or will their conflicts tear their love apart?
description.zh: 【你不可错过的萌到跺脚的宝藏漫画！】一场意外，软萌忠犬美山匪把风流可爱俏公子捡回了家，一段可可爱爱令人捧腹的故事就此展开：“本公子从没见过这样的山匪，软软糯糯，还爱哭，这让人怎么把持得住？！嘿嘿~最后谁是谁的压寨夫人还不一定呢~”
description.es-la: Ruan Tang, un noble encantador, casi pierde la vida a manos de un miserable príncipe. Afortunadamente, despierta para encontrarse a sí mismo en la casa de A-Cheng, ¡un hermoso extraño (que resulta ser un bandido) que lo salvó! Mientras se recupera en las montañas, el inesperado par forma un vínculo, pero, eventualmente ambos se van por caminos separados. Sin embargo, incluso así, ninguno puede dejar de pensar en el otro… ¿Habrá un final feliz para ellos, o los conflictos destruirán su amor?

attributes.name: Bai Gui Sui Xing (百鬼随行)

description.en:
"Qi Zheng Emperor Sheng Lingyuan was reawakened a thousand years later after he jumped off the fiery Red Lake.

Xuan Ji, a newly transferred staff to the Reparations Division of the Deviant Control Office, finds himself having to clean up the mess of a revived tyrannical monarch.

The two seemed to share something from the past, but unbeknownst to them, a big conspiracy is stirring right underneath their noses that could destroy the balance of the world."
description.es-la: Sheng Lingyuan lleva mucho tiempo muerto, desde que saltó al abismo rojo en ChiYuan, es decir, hasta que fue "despertado" por una fuerza desconocida tres mil años después.Xuan Ji es el recién nombrado líder del Equipo de Reacción Inmediata, que ayuda a controlar y limpiar el desorden cada vez que ocurren sucesos sobrenaturales.Los dos se unen por un evento extraño, y miles de años de conspiración y planificación cuidadosa comienzan a desarrollarse ante ellos.

description.en:
A virtual reality platform for gamers to fight as magicians, warriors, healers, and whichever fighting class they choose.  
  
However, the fight has spread beyond the internet, escalating into real bloodshed. In reality, our male lead fell victim right before the final round of the game’s ultimate championship.  
  
He closed his eyes, vowing to seek revenge. He re-opened his eyes, a new day had dawned—a “new” day, two years ago, right before the game was officially released. Memories of the past two years, predictions for the next two years, he who relived it all shall rule it all!

description.en:
Xing Tian has suffered many setbacks his entire life. He fell from being a Divine god to a god of war, and then again from being a god of war to a demon king. There has only been one person he longs for and chases after, but that person has forgotten about him again and again. Xing Tian consoles himself: it’s alright, he is a fish after all. And fishes…don’t have good memory…

T/N: This manhua and its characters are based on ancient Chinese mythology recorded in Shanhaijing, or the Classic of Mountains and Seas.

As the war-torn kingdoms vie for power in Ancient China, a deadly yet beautiful struggle also emerges in the seraglio of the King of Ding (King Xun)! In order to gain the terrifying King Xun's favor, Ninghu's family is determined to make her the future Queen, but King Xun is not interested in his other concubines at all. Not willing to become just another neglected concubine, Ninghu disguises herself as an eunuch servant to her brother Yuanren, the second most powerful eunuch and adviser in the kingdom. However, the moment that she enters the Scarlet Palace, Lingyu, the most influential and favored eunuch, suspects that she is a girl and begins to investigate her! With the mysterious death of Lingyu's original servant, Ninghu decides to become Lingyu's personal servant in hope to approach King Xun. However, King Xun is absent from the palace, and as time goes on, Lingyu and Ninghu becomes more and more attracted to each other! Could they have fallen in love with each other?!
A princess calls upon a hero to kill the newly born demon king and that's how the story begins…!
description.pt-br: Uma princessa chama um herói para matar o recém-nascido Rei Demônio, e é assim que a história começa…!

description.en:
Out of the blue, Jiang Yu transmigrates into a xiuxian novel. But who decided that she only deserves to be a small fry who barely even counts as cannon fodder in the novel? And why is she suddenly bound to a useless retribution system? She's not only the bottom-of-the-barrel weakest of the weak, but she's also a tiny black sheep who gets made an example of in the first few chapters of the book! 

And yet, Jiang Yu is not entirely helpless. Using her quick wit and cunning, she forges out the path of a self-reliant, feminist-ideal heroine when they least expect it.

The universe is invaded by destructive forces. An organization determined to control such forces; An investigator committed to seek the truth behind his childhood nightmares; A cold-faced woman shouldering her family's curse... A terrifying tale has unfolded in the mysterious town.

description.en: My genius best friend went on a mission and encountered a god. He turned into a girl and came back, suddenly saying that he wants to help me become stronger. I was very confused, but seeing how enthusiastic he was (and how good his figure is), I followed his instructions.

Even for the monk's unruly disciplines, and even for the ill ways of the evil spirits, and even among the various calamities of the mortal world, that mountain is still that mountain, and that temple is still that temple. One Buddhist Master greeted those arriving and sent those departing for each tale, and there is always the one that will make you cry and smile.

description.en: The rich second generation Lee Feng discovered overnight that his parents had disappeared in the name of traveling around the world together. The company went bankrupt and all the assets of the family were frozen. He became a pauper, and his beloved girlfriend had to break up with him. Fortunately, his parents left him an apartment as the last resort. The disheartened Lee Feng went to take over the apartment, but found that the house called "One Apartment" had turned into a mysterious "Taixu Apartment", and Lee Feng also became the owner of this apartment...
